items.heading: The Degree Gives
items.text: The degree gives you a computing foundation (programming, databases, networks, OS basics), not a finished specialisation employers hire for directly.

items.heading: Choose Between Bca, Btech,
items.text: Choose between BCA, BTech, and BSc Computer Science by the track you want to go deep in, not by which degree name sounds stronger.

items.heading: BCA Without Mca Can Still
items.text: BCA without MCA can still work well, MCA only makes sense in specific situations, not by default.
